lineage.strategy: Add a materially different deployment/customer ecosystem signal rather than repeat foundry funding evidence.

observations.fact: IBM and Lockheed Martin established a Swiss quantum innovation hub at ETH Zurich under an offset agreement with armasuisse, with an IBM Quantum System Two planned for the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre.
IBM says it will operate the System Two using its Nighthawk processor, creating an institutional deployment path beyond IBM-operated U.S. infrastructure.

risks.risk: A planned institutional system deployment and research hub do not establish commercial quantum revenue, utilization, error-correction economics or customer ROI.

unknowns.unknown: Contract economics, deployment timing milestones, utilization and revenue contribution are not disclosed in the release.

recommendation: Use as separate deployment/ecosystem execution evidence; do not infer quantum economics from institutional adoption alone.
